plugins.description: Back up a Postgres database and prove the backup restores. /restoreproof:restoreproof runs `npx --allow-git=root github:agentwares/restoreproof` to test a restore now (before a migration, say) or to add the weekly restore-tested backup workflow to this repository, and explains what came back table by table.
